about_the_game:
The music of Mega Man, Mega Man X, and Mega Man Legends gets masterfully arranged by the rocking "ROCK-MEN" of the Capcom Sound Team! A must-listen for any game music fan!

The soundtrack has been reauthored from the original, high quality source material. Formats include MP3 (V0), FLAC (16-bit), and AAC (VBR).
